analysis.title: The Ultimate 2000 Irony Ericsson Now Trades At A 50% Premium To Nvidia
key_insights: Ericsson traded at a 50% valuation premium to NVDA this week, which the note frames as a year-2000 style valuation extreme.
Hedge fund positioning in AI stocks is back to summer 2023 levels (GS Prime).
Big tech is still spending heavily: $1.3tn of AI capex is expected in 2027 against -$283bn of free cash flow (Flow Show).
Semiconductor earnings revisions breadth is rolling over, despite the view that the sector is no longer cyclical (Morgan Stanley).

The S&P 500 ex-Mag 7 (the 'Other 493') is outpacing the Mag 7 in EPS growth one quarter ahead of schedule, for the first time since Q4'22. Analysts expect it to continue in Q4 at 30.8% vs 24.1% (FactSet).
Morgan Stanley's Global Risk Demand Index is in clear fear territory.
Investors are paid more to own high-quality credit than equities, with less volatility. IG yields are the furthest above the S&P 500 earnings yield since the early 2000s (Apollo).
earnings_insights: The Other 493 are outpacing the Mag 7 in EPS growth one quarter ahead of schedule, the first time since Q4'22. Analyst estimates (FactSet) for Q4 are 30.8% for the Other 493 vs 24.1% for the Mag 7.
